title: SPECTACLE DISTRIBUTION PROJECT
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons, in association with Ratna Nidhi Foundation, organised a spectacle distribution programme at The Public High School, Kandivali East, on 19th October 2026.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons, in association with Ratna Nidhi Foundation, organised a spectacle distribution programme at The Public High School, Kandivali East, on 19th October 2026. Spectacles were distributed to students identified during an eye check-up camp conducted last month. This initiative aims to improve students' vision, support their education and ensure better eye health.
